hero.title: Postgraduate Chemical Engineering in Switzerland in Switzerland for Indian Students
hero.subtitle: A **Master’s in Chemical Engineering in Switzerland** is a great choice for those interested in chemical processes, process design, biotechnology, material science, energy systems and sustainable industrial production. Swiss universities provide advanced scientific education coupled with research in chemical reaction engineering, separation processes, polymers and environmental technologies.

highlights.eligibility: Bachelor's degree in Engineering + English/German proficiency

overview:
**Study Master’s in Chemical Engineering in Switzerland** for advanced scientific education, research opportunities, and specialized training in chemical and industrial processes. A **Master’s in Chemical Engineering in Switzerland for Indian Students** can provide opportunities to explore advanced research and specialized engineering education.

ETH Zurich is one of the key institutions for Indian students to explore, for studies related to Chemical Engineering. Other Swiss universities may have similar programs in process engineering, biotechnology, materials science or energy technology but without the name “Chemical Engineering”. Ensure that you check the curriculum and eligibility criteria before applying.

**Edu-Hawk Worldwide** can help students understand international university options and plan their study abroad applications.

Currency Note: All financial estimates are based on an exchange rate of CHF 1 \= INR 110 for planning purposes. Tuition fees, living costs and exchange rates are subject to change.

faq.question: How long is a Master's in Chemical Engineering in Switzerland?
faq.answer: The Chemical and Bioengineering program at ETH Zurich normally takes 1.5 years (90 ECTS credits). The Chemical Engineering and Biotechnology program at EPFL is made up of 120 ECTS credits and is typically designed as a two-year degree.
